result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭、第二貨源與集中度的負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#1/#2、end_markets#3、customer_concentration_credit#0/#1）都已進 threats、blind_spots、R1/R3 與 contradictions，未見漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.triggers","reason":"事實表的 supply_demand_durability 軸有 5 條 finding，但負向條目子集中沒有該軸；判斷以第一廠產能瓶頸與第二廠上機時程處理供給，Bear 機率也有交代，沒看到明確漏接，但無法核對該軸負向條目。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"關稅（reg_tariff_export#0/#2）、地緣供應鏈、替代技術、集體訴訟與 ITC 都已進 blind_spots、R4、triggers 與 single_thing。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.market_wrong_reason_given","reason":"market_wrong_reason_given=false 與裁決觀望一致；wait_for_price=true 且條件具體可驗（180 美元，或第四季權利金至少 4,300 萬且產品營收季增約 10%），並無矛盾。小瑕疵是 oneliner 與 q5 寫「不追」，但 val 燈為中性，並非判斷錯誤。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.evidence_dismissed","reason":"程式判定為綠；十二軸皆 found，查詢切題，q2、q3 都交代同業 ROIC、份額、投入資本等未涵蓋項目對結論的影響。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🔴","judgment_path":"$.scenario_inputs.endo_ceiling_exceeded","reason":"endo_ceiling 為 null 且 reinvest_rate／roiic 無算式，但 scenario_inputs.endo_ceiling_exceeded=true 與 q3 的「內生上界算不出」自相矛盾；共識 EPS 三年年複合約 47% 與天花板的對帳無法完成，而 formula_note 只說缺資料，無真算。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.reasoning","reason":"引用的營運指標（營收 1.971 億、毛利率 68.3%、backlog 4.06 億、現金 5.13 億）皆為 Q3 FY2026，與事實表最新 as_of 相同；共識修正無被當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"前份 drift_watch 中有值的欄位（signal、val、ma、trap、price_at_dd）都已映射到帶 cause 的條目；ma 與價格由程式歸因，val 為價格變動，signal 與 trap 為新證據，其餘前份空欄以方法補欄處理。"}]
